title: VRVLOG_object_toggle_transforms 1
description: Local transforms of the nodes (bones) that the avatar's VRChat Expression Menu toggles move, sampled like VRVLOG_object_toggles with every other parameter at its default. Each group extends the VRVLOG_object_toggles group with the same parameter. Each state gives, for one value of the parameter, the transform of every target node: Unity local values (not converted to glTF space), absolute rather than relative to the written rest pose. A target lists the properties the toggle moves, and its transforms carry exactly those. Rules that span objects are validated by the shared reader (ObjectToggleTransformData.Read): the extension is read only with a valid VRVLOG_object_toggles; every group names a VRVLOG_object_toggles group and parameters are unique (ordinal); a group's state values are unique and are exactly the state values of that VRVLOG_object_toggles group; a node index appears at most once over all groups and the whole extension has at most 4096 targets; every transforms array has as many entries as the group's targets; properties are in the order translation, rotation, scale; a rotation has length 1 within 0.001. Node indices must be less than the glTF node count.
